General B2B Marketplaces
IndiaMART
: India's largest online B2B marketplace. It has a huge list of local buyers and sellers.
TradeIndia
: A major platform for small and medium businesses. It helps find industrial goods and local trade events.
Alibaba India
: The local arm of the global giant. It helps Indian sellers export goods to buyers around the world.
ExportersIndia
: A portal focused on connecting Indian makers with buyers in other countries.
Global Trade Plaza
: A fast-growing trading site for wholesale buyers and sellers.
Global Trade Plaza
Wholesale and Supply Chain Platforms
Udaan
: A mobile-first B2B market built for small shop owners, wholesalers, and makers. It includes credit and delivery options.
Amazon Business
: The B2B branch of Amazon. It offers tax-compliant bills and bulk buying for companies.
Moglix
: A digital platform focused on industrial supplies, tools, and factory goods.
Flipkart Wholesale
: A digital B2B marketplace that mainly serves retail shops and fashion stores.
OfBusiness
: A platform that combines raw material supply with business credit.
